chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Abu al-Abbas, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
There is no Itikaaf (seclusion in the mosque) except with fasting.

key_terms.اعْتِكَاف: Itikaaf: Seclusion in the mosque for worship

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the validity of Itikaaf according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes fasting as a prerequisite condition (*shart*) for the validity of Itikaaf, reflecting the predominant view in Shia jurisprudence that distinguishes it from the Hanafi position. This ruling underscores the spiritual discipline required for seclusion, linking the physical act of worship with the ascetic practice of fasting to purify the heart for divine communion.
